title: Dual-Class Prompt Generation: Enhancing Indonesian Gender-Based Hate Speech Detection through Data Augmentation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of machine learning models (Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, Random Forest, and XGBoost) in detecting gender-based hate speech in an Indonesian Twitter dataset. The evaluation uses accuracy and F1-score metrics to measure how effectively different data augmentation techniques (specifically dual-class prompt generation and backtranslation) improve model performance and mitigate prediction bias caused by severe class imbalance.
